# 3 B's Tree Removal

> Tree removal for Central & Southwest Louisiana.

3 B's Tree Removal is based in Pitkin, Louisiana. Blake Berry is a Louisiana Licensed Arborist for tree work. The site is https://3bs.getpros.xyz/.

## Services

- Tree removal
- Stumps
- Land clearing
- Dirt work
- Storm cleanup

## Service area

Pitkin, Central Louisiana, and Southwest Louisiana. The page lists Vernon, Beauregard, Rapides, Allen, Sabine, and Calcasieu parishes as the starting coverage area.
